name: React + Vite
summary: A React app that runs entirely in the browser, built with the Vite tool.

free_plan_covers.note: React and Vite are free and open source under the MIT license.

first_paid_usd_month.note: No paid plan. The tools are free.

portability.note: The build is plain static files that any host can serve.

language.note: Written in TypeScript or JavaScript with React components.

has_server_code.note: Everything is bundled and sent to the browser. There is no private server code unless you add a separate backend.

uses_react.note: The Vite React template builds a React app.

setup.step: Create the app with npm create vite@latest, choose React, and push it to a GitHub repository.

builder_notes: Everything in this app ships to the browser. Never include secret keys; anything private must go through a server or a backend service.
Only variables prefixed VITE_ are exposed to the app, and they are public.
